_doc: The cities of this planet in play order (design spec section 1; systems/districts.gd). Each one is a chapter. stage_share: the share of a city's land hexes that must have reached a regrowth stage for the city to be at that stage. open_ground_rings: region size of a hub site that is not a city (open ground: optional, counted only for the whole planet). open_ground_travel: when the rocket offers open-ground sites: 'all_unlocked' = once every city is unlocked, 'always', 'never'. districts[]: id (never changes once shipped: saves use it), name (shown to the player, translated where shown), site (index of the hub site the city stands on), rings (size: the hexes within this many rings of the site's hex, 1 + 3r(r+1) of them away from the grid's twelve five-sided cells), pollution (the pollution kinds its hexes hold; read by the pollution system, not by districts.gd), unlock (the rule that opens the city: {type: 'start'} = open from a new game; {type: 'district_stage', district, stage} = when that city reaches that stage). Sizes and the unlock stage are the accepted balance numbers (design spec section 17).
